newsitem.headline: Medpartners Q4 shr excluding charges $0.26.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTES: 1995 results restated to show impact of pooling-of-interests transactions including the acquisition of Cardinal Healthcare and Sheer, Ahearn and Associates.
In full year 1996 the company posted a $71.2 million loss from discontinued operations and a $2.5 million net gain on sales of discontinued operations.
In full year 1995 the company posted a $168.3 milion loss from discontinued operations and a $31.8 million net gain on sales of discontinued operations.
In the fourth quarter 1995 the company posted a $15.9 million loss from discontinued operations and a $24.7 million net gain from on sales of discontinued operations.
Full company name is Medpartners Inc.
